title: How Armstrong could play so high
summary: Randolph tried to copy Armstrong's open-mouth high-note embouchure in a mirror and cannot understand how air did not escape.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Did Louis talk much about his way of playing? Did he have any secrets or how he could play so high, because he was playing higher than anybody. At that time, he was playing higher than anybody.
At that time, he was playing higher than anybody. No, but I got before the mirror and tried to adapt that style, but I don't see -- and that's why playing
with my mouth open and showing my -- and he plays and his teeth -- did you ever see Louis close, did you ever see him close up?
And you see his mouth and you see all his teeth?
See his teeth when he's making his high notes? I don't know how on earth (Unintelligible) the man do that.
Yeah, it looks like air would escape.
